# Cue Kit

> Open-source, Awwwards-tier React components with the AI prompts that designed them. MIT licensed. Install with shadcn CLI. 40+ free components, weekly drops.

Cue Kit is the free, OSS entry point for Cue's premium component library ([Cue+](https://cuedesign.space)). Every component ships two things: the polished React source and the exact AI prompt used to design it — so you can drop the code in via shadcn or regenerate a themed variant in v0 / Bolt / Cursor / Framer AI / Claude.

## Positioning

- **Free** — MIT license, no signup, no rate limit, no attribution required
- **Awwwards-tier** — every component hand-tuned against reference sites; no filler ever shipped
- **Prompt-first** — the prompt is the deliverable alongside code, so AI tools can adapt each component to any design system
- **shadcn-compatible** — one-command install into any Next.js + Tailwind project

## Install

```
npx shadcn@latest add https://kit.cuedesign.space/r/[slug].json
```

Package managers: `bun`, `npm`, `pnpm`, `yarn` all supported.

## Components

Browse the full library at [kit.cuedesign.space](https://kit.cuedesign.space). Categories:

- **Buttons** — magnetic, isometric, ripple
- **Cards** — tilt, phantom-gallery, collapsing accordion
- **Inputs** — toggles, forms
- **Layouts** — bento grids, split panels, sticky cascades
- **Motion** — scroll-pinned sequences, gooey drops, text reveals
- **Overlays** — dynamic-island notches, modals
- **Typography** — dot-matrix cascade, color-band reveals

Each component has its own detail page at `/components/[slug]`.

## Weekly cadence

- 5 new components ship weekly to Cue Kit
- 10+ ship weekly to Cue+
